title: Reassign lead technician lists eligible technicians and Unassigned
custom_preconds:
1. Sign in to the Work Orders build under test as a user whose role has Work Orders view and Work Orders create and edit. To check: Settings > Roles & Permissions > open the role > Work Orders (an Owner or Admin role has both).
  2. Use a desktop browser window at least 1024 px wide. Narrower windows show only the List, without the display switcher.
  3. In the top bar, pick the location you will test in (e.g. "Heavy Duty") and stay in it for the whole case.
  4. At least 3 technicians are eligible at this location (e.g. "Esther Howard", "Ralph Edwards", "Dana Ortiz"). A staff member is eligible when Clockable is on, the staff record is Active, the role is neither Office nor Time Clock User, and they are enrolled at this location. To add one:
    • Settings > Staff > add a staff member, enter a first and last name (e.g. "Dana Ortiz") and an email.
    • Pick a role that is not Office or Time Clock User (e.g. "Technician"), turn Clockable on, keep the record Active, enrol the staff member at this location, then Save.
  5. Three staff members who must NOT be offered: an Office-role user (e.g. "Owen Office"), a technician whose staff record you set to Inactive (e.g. "Ivan Inactive"), and a technician enrolled only at another location (e.g. "Lena Otherloc"). Create them the same way under Settings > Staff.
  6. Create a customer used only by this case so a search shows only its work orders: Customers > New Customer, name (e.g. "ZZ Board Test Co"), add an asset with a unit number and year/make/model (e.g. unit "TRK-118", "2022 Freightliner M2"), then Save.
  7. Create the work order: Work Orders > New Work Order > pick the case customer (e.g. "ZZ Board Test Co") and its asset > create it, and write down its number (e.g. "S1-702").
    • On the work order page set Lead Technician to "Esther Howard".
    • On the Lines tab click New Line, enter a name (e.g. "Brake inspection") and labor hours (e.g. 2.0), and save the line.
    • Click the line's Approve (check) button so the work order status reads Approved.
custom_steps:
1. Open Work Orders, click the All tab and pick Board View in the display switcher (right side of the toolbar; in the design its button tooltip reads "Board").
  2. Type the case customer's name (e.g. "ZZ Board Test Co") in Search.
  3. Hover the work order's card (e.g. "S1-702") in Esther Howard's column and click its More actions (…) button.
  4. Choose Reassign lead technician.
  5. Read every choice listed in the dialog.
  6. Pick Ralph Edwards and confirm the dialog with its confirm button (e.g. "Reassign").
  7. If a "Clear …'s scheduled shifts?" prompt opens, click Keep shifts.
  8. Open the same card's More actions menu again and choose Reassign lead technician.
  9. Pick Unassigned and confirm.
  10. If a "Clear …'s scheduled shifts?" prompt opens, click Keep shifts.
  11. Open the card's More actions menu again (it is now in the Unassigned column) and choose Reassign lead technician.
  12. Pick Dana Ortiz, then click Cancel.
  13. Open the work order (click the card) and read Lead Technician.
  14. Go back, pick Tech View in the display switcher and repeat steps 3 to 13 using the row's More actions button.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • The card's More actions menu (and the Tech View row's) offers Reassign lead technician, and choosing it opens the Reassign lead technician dialog.
  • The dialog lists Unassigned and the eligible technicians of this location, e.g. Esther Howard, Ralph Edwards and Dana Ortiz. Owen Office, Ivan Inactive and Lena Otherloc are not listed.
  • After picking Ralph Edwards and confirming, the card is in Ralph Edwards' column (the row in his group), and the work order page shows Lead Technician Ralph Edwards. After picking Unassigned and confirming, the card is in the Unassigned column and the work order has no lead technician.
  • After Cancel, nothing changes: the card stays in Unassigned and the work order still has no lead technician.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10043; story SV-10047 (Story 4, Reassign or unassign the lead technician); PRD Confluence 845185030, edited 7 Oct 2026 (status line "PRD v33"), S4-R4, S4-R12, S4-R13, S4-R14, read 8 Oct 2026. Eligibility from PRD §5 Terminology (Technician) and S2-R7. Design export of 8 Oct 2026 (Claude Design project 787fef1a, Work Orders.dc.html): card and row More actions (…) button and the reassign dialog (title "Reassign Lead Tech", search "Search technicians", Cancel). Source-verified 8 October 2026; not yet build-verified.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S4-R4: “The card or row more-actions menu opens the Reassign lead technician dialog.”
  • S4-R12: “The dialog offers eligible active technicians in the current location and Unassigned.”
  • S4-R13: “Confirming the dialog changes the lead to the selected technician or Unassigned.”
  • S4-R14: “Canceling the dialog leaves the lead unchanged.”
